sentences.text: 1 The authenticity of the order can be re-

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 10/11/2023 at 22:23:46 petitioner/landowners compensation amount in lieu of his acquired land bearing property no. B-II/ 52, 53 & 54, Mohan Cooperative Industrial Area, Mathura Road, Village Tajpul, New Delhi, as assessed and determined vide Award bearing No. 1/2009-10 dated 25.08.2009 alongwith statutory interest thereupon in terms of the provisions of Land Acquisition Act, 1894."

2. The dispute appears to emanate from a failure on the part of the respondents to release the amount of compensation along with statutory interest as claimed by the petitioner under Sections 31 and 34 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 ["Act"] and which stood determined in terms of an Award dated 25 August 2009.

3. Before this Court, it is not disputed that the beneficiaries of the acquisition process had handed over the requisite funds in the hands of the Land Acquisition Collector ["LAC"] at the relevant point in time.
It is, however, asserted before us that the aforesaid amounts were utilized to meet liabilities flowing from other Awards which had been rendered.
4. On the last occasion, we had accorded liberty to Mr. Pathak, learned counsel appearing for the LAC to take appropriate instructions from the first respondent.

Based on the aforesaid, Mr. Pathak,
on the basis of instructions provided by the Additional Chief Secretary, GNCTD states that the LAC proposes to initiate appropriate proceedings referable to Section 30 and Section 31 of the Act and would consequently take appropriate steps to deposit the entire amount payable up to date along with statutory interest before the competent court which may be moved in connection with the above.
He further states that appropriate steps shall be taken in this regard within a period of three months from today.
The statement so made is recorded and accepted.

5. Subject to the consideration and disposal of the Section 30 and This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 10/11/2023 at 22:23:46 Section 31 applications by the competent court, we provide that the amount of compensation which the respondents propose to deposit shall be released accordingly.

6. Bearing in mind the fact that the Award itself is of 25 August 2009, we would request the concerned court which may be petitioned in this respect to move with due expedition and with adequate notice to all concerned parties.
7. Subject to the aforesaid observation, this petition along with pending applications shall stand disposed of.

YASHWANT VARMA, J.
RAVINDER DUDEJA, J.
